name: ADC India Communications Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, ADC India Communications Ltd manufactures and trades Telecommunications & IT Networking products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
ADCICL offers connectivity solutions to suit individual enterprise and telecom service provider requirements. It provides copper and fiber physical connectivity in telecommunications and data networking solutions including structured cabling.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 45.1% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 29.2%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 48.6%
cons: Stock is trading at 7.90 times its book value
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 65.0% of their holding.
